_comment: 知识图谱统一 Schema 定义 — 前后端共用
_description: 修改此文件即可同步更新前后端。前端通过 /lib/schema.ts 自动解析，后端通过 schema_api.py 提供 API。

EquipmentType.label: 设备类型
EquipmentType.description: 二级设备分类，如无人机、坦克等

Environment.label: 环境节点
Environment.description: 试验环境，如复杂电磁环境、复杂地理环境等

queryTemplates.getEquipmentTypes: MATCH (et:EquipmentType) RETURN et ORDER BY et.name
queryTemplates.getEquipmentByType: MATCH (et:EquipmentType {id: $typeId})-[:HAS]->(e:Equipment) RETURN e ORDER BY e.name
queryTemplates.getProjectsByEquipment: MATCH (e:Equipment {id: $equipmentId})-[:CON_EQUIP_PROJECT]->(p:Project) RETURN p ORDER BY p.name
queryTemplates.getProjectsByEnvironment: MATCH (env:Environment {id: $environmentId})-[:CON_ENV_PROJECT]->(p:Project) RETURN p ORDER BY p.name
queryTemplates.getProjectsByEquipmentAndEnvironment: MATCH (e:Equipment {id: $equipmentId})-[:CON_EQUIP_PROJECT]->(p:Project)<-[:CON_ENV_PROJECT]-(env:Environment {id: $environmentId}) RETURN p, env ORDER BY p.name
queryTemplates.getIndicatorsByEquipment: MATCH (e:Equipment {id: $equipmentId})-[:CON_EQUIP_INDICATOR]->(i:Indicator) RETURN i ORDER BY i.name
queryTemplates.getMethodsByProject: MATCH (p:Project {id: $projectId})-[:CON_PROJECT_METHOD]->(m:Method) RETURN m ORDER BY m.name
queryTemplates.getMethodsByIndicator: MATCH (i:Indicator {id: $indicatorId})-[:CON_INDICATOR_METHOD]->(m:Method) RETURN m ORDER BY m.name
queryTemplates.getMethodsByProjectAndIndicator: MATCH (p:Project)-[:CON_PROJECT_METHOD]->(m:Method)<-[:CON_INDICATOR_METHOD]-(i:Indicator) WHERE p.id IN $projectIds OR i.id IN $indicatorIds RETURN m, p, i
queryTemplates.getAllEnvironments: MATCH (env:Environment) RETURN env ORDER BY env.name
queryTemplates.getNodesByType: MATCH (n:NodeType) RETURN n ORDER BY n.name
queryTemplates.searchNodes: MATCH (n) WHERE n.name CONTAINS $keyword RETURN labels(n)[0] AS nodeType, n ORDER BY n.name
